notes:
Summary: Mid-market SaaS (ConvoCraft) building a chat-first agent for SaaS product support. Primary evaluation is Hosted API for fast time-to-value, with plan to move to Dedicated once throughput and residency needs justify it.

POC status / technical notes:
- POC running (2-week plan). Focus: streaming start-of-response latency + end-to-end tool-calling latency (external search + ticket creation).
- 99th pct target: <= 400ms for first token in typical 2-turn convo (customer goal). Currently seeing ~220-280ms median, 99p ~520ms on hosted during peak — needs improvement or canary routing.
- Streaming: they want server-sent-events style streaming for immediate first-byte + incremental tokens for UI. Verified SDK streaming path works in prototype.
- Tool calling: using retrieval + sync HTTP webhook to create tickets; concerned about fan-out latency. Want a strategy for async tool calls and optimistic UI.
- Prompting & evals: Asking for prompt/eval regression gating. They want Redwood Optimize + A/B + canary rollouts: gate on end-to-end task metrics (resolution rate / action success), not just perplexity.
- Proposed rollout plan: Run A/B between current prompt + compressed prompt variant; start 5% traffic -> 25% -> 100% if no regression on eval set and no latency regression. SE suggested automated rollback policy on quality delta > 1.5% or 99p latency increase > 15%.

Commercial / procurement:
- Cost sensitivity: mid-market budget, want clear unit economics. Interested in batching/quantization suggestions from Redwood Optimize to reduce token cost without breaking agent prompts.
- Interested in Dedicated pricing: predictable throughput with burst capacity for peak support windows.

Security / compliance:
- Must pass SOC2 review and SSO integration (SAML). Need audit logging and KMS integration for secrets. EU data residency for customers in EMEA is a hard requirement for some enterprise customers they serve.

Quotes / call snippets:
- "We need first-byte consistency — users notice jitter more than avg latency." — Head of Product
- "Canary rollouts with quality gates are non-negotiable for support flows." — Engineering Manager

Next steps / owner action items:
- SE (Jordan) to run targeted 99p latency profiling on streaming path and try configuration changes (batching windows, KV cache heuristics).
- AE (Maya) to deliver Dedicated pricing deck and comparison sheet (drive:/decks/convocraft-redwood-pricing-v2.pdf).
- Security: send SOC2 artifact + KMS integration docs; schedule call with ConvoCraft security team week of 2026-03-01.
- Set up A/B canary test plan doc (prototype thresholds + rollback rules) and schedule joint run during POC second week.
